entities.name: Query CoaBC protein
observations: 399 aa protein; calculated molecular mass 43.4 kDa and theoretical pI 8.36.
Pfam-like domains: N-terminal flavoprotein domain PF02441 spanning residues 3-179 and C-terminal DFP domain PF04127 spanning residues 186-397.
Has 44.1% identity and 99.5% query coverage to reviewed Haemophilus influenzae CoaBC (P44953), and 41.8% identity and 98.5% coverage to Bacillus subtilis CoaBC (O35033).

entities.name: CoaBC
observations: Bifunctional coenzyme A biosynthesis enzyme catalyzing phosphopantothenate--cysteine ligase and phosphopantothenoylcysteine decarboxylase activities.
Uses CTP in the ligase step and requires Mg2+; binds one FMN per subunit for the decarboxylase module.
Catalyzes sequential CoA-biosynthetic steps 2 and 3 from (R)-pantothenate.

entities.name: 4-phosphopantothenate cysteine ligation
observations: (R)-4'-phosphopantothenate + L-cysteine + CTP → N-[(R)-4-phosphopantothenoyl]-L-cysteine + CMP + diphosphate + H+; Rhea RHEA:19397 and EC 6.3.2.5.

entities.name: Phosphopantothenoylcysteine decarboxylation
observations: N-[(R)-4-phosphopantothenoyl]-L-cysteine + H+ → (R)-4'-phosphopantetheine + CO2; Rhea RHEA:16793 and EC 4.1.1.36.

entities.name: Coenzyme A biosynthesis
observations: CoaBC performs steps 2 and 3 of bacterial CoA biosynthesis from (R)-pantothenate.
